findings.title: Rollback equivalence discards concurrent optional Action edits
findings.cause: canonicalReaction retains only type/destinationId/navigation/transition. Official NODE actions also permit preserveScrollPosition, overlayRelativePosition, resetVideoPosition, resetScrollPosition and resetInteractiveComponents. Equivalent therefore ignores meaningful extra flags both at postcondition and before rollback.
findings.reproduction: Using the supplied fixture in memory only, select the ninth planned mutation. Wrap its setter to apply the requested reaction, add resetInteractiveComponents=true to that actual action to represent a concurrent edit, then throw a synthetic interruption. The proposal returns ROLLED_BACK with unresolved=[] and finalReaction=[]: the added flag/reaction was erased. No Figma call or saved source change occurred.
findings.impact: Violates the stated concurrency safeguard: a reaction with a concurrent legal Action-property change can be treated as the script-owned write and replaced by before=[]. It also permits extra same-core action flags to pass final scope checks.
findings.requested_change: Compare the complete semantically relevant Reaction/Action/Trigger contract, explicitly handling only documented readback aliases/defaults. Do not discard optional Action settings. Rollback must refuse a current value differing from the exact admitted script-owned result; preserve that edit and report its ID unresolved. Add a focused synthetic optional-property concurrency case.

findings.title: Failure return can exceed the provider 20 KB output bound
findings.cause: The 18000-byte admission checks the success report only. Catch appends up to106 per-node error strings truncated by160 JavaScript characters plus a500-character top-level error, then returns without a UTF-8 byte bound.
findings.reproduction: Using the supplied fixture in memory only, allow all106 new reaction assignments, throw on the106th after assignment, then make each rollback setter reject with a180-character CJK error. The actual returned report is ROLLBACK_INCOMPLETE with106 unresolved IDs and54428 UTF-8 bytes. All provided sources and saved7-case result remain unchanged.
findings.impact: A partial-write/rollback failure can lose the diagnostic response at the exact recovery point where the full set of affected and unresolved IDs is essential. The proposal cannot currently claim every output remains below20KB.
findings.requested_change: Bound the final UTF-8 serialization on every path. Preserve all affected/unresolved IDs with compact stable error codes and a globally bounded error summary rather than unconstrained per-ID text. Test maximum106-node rollback failure including non-ASCII errors and assert the final emitted payload stays below the safe limit.
